## Home

Sehaj automates the boring parts, wires up LLM agents, and ships backends that hold up.

Hero intro: "I'm Sehaj Varma — an AI automation and backend engineer from India. I build Python/Flask APIs, LLM agents, RAG pipelines, and the scripts that quietly do the work nobody wants to do twice."

### Selected work: Amai Yuki

A real-time messaging app, from zero to shipped.

The problem: off-the-shelf messaging backends own your data flow, your latency, and every feature they never bothered to expose. Sehaj wanted the protocol layer and the camera module to be his — so he stopped negotiating with someone else's API and built the thing from zero.

Build log:
- A Flask REST backend on SQLite. Every route validates its input — the first version didn't, and it bit him exactly once before that was fixed permanently.
- Direct and group chat over the project's own protocol layer, not a rented one.
- A camera module built into the Flutter app itself — the capture features other backends don't expose.
- LLM features layered into chat, driven by prompt orchestration so they behave on a Tuesday as well as they did in the demo.

The result: it works. The frontend is open-source and runnable today at https://github.com/mrsehajofficial/Amai-Yuki; the backend stays private, partly for security and partly because the early migrations embarrass Sehaj. Frontend polish moved faster with AI tooling — under his direction, not the other way around.

Tags: Python, Flask, Provider, LLM, Flutter. Year: 2026.

### More evidence

- Automation scripts: 10+ private Python tools — scheduled jobs, file-processing pipelines, API-to-API glue. One runs at 6am, moves three kinds of files, and emails only when something goes wrong. That's the point: the good ones you never think about.
- AI / RAG experiments: OpenAI and Gemini integrations, prompt orchestration systems, RAG architecture studies. Most feed Amai Yuki's LLM-assisted features. The interesting engineering isn't the demo — it's the gap between demo and reliable.
- This site itself: a static Next.js build, server-rendered, zero external calls, with a client-side retrieval engine that answers questions from the site's own facts.

### About (colophon)

Sehaj likes problems with edges; software has the most edges.

- "I'm Sehaj. I build automation and backends from India, and I work remotely with anyone, anywhere."
- "The whole thing clicked for me because of logic puzzles. There's a specific satisfaction in watching a script do, in six seconds, the task you used to lose an afternoon to."
- Currently deep in AI integrations: prompt orchestration, RAG architecture, agents that actually call external APIs instead of hallucinating an answer.
- On the backend side: Flask REST APIs on clean SQLite schemas, input validation on every route, modular structure, and documentation good enough that future-me doesn't curse present-me.

Focus areas: Workflow Automation, Clean API Structures, AI API Integrations, System Scripting.
Stats: 10+ automation scripts built · 4+ AI integration prototypes · 4+ deployment platforms shipped to.

### Stack

Grouped by what is delivered, not by logo wall; everything is something shipped or used in real projects.

- AI: OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, Agents, Prompt orchestration. OpenAI and Gemini integrations run inside Amai Yuki's chat features; prompt orchestration keeps outputs reliable; RAG architecture and agents that call external APIs are the current deep-dive.
- Backend: Python, Flask, REST APIs, SQLite. The pattern: Flask REST APIs on clean SQLite schemas, modular code, validation on every route, docs you can actually read.
- Automation: Python scripting, Scheduled jobs, File processing, API integrations. 10+ private scripts; each exists because he got tired of doing the same thing twice.
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Flutter, Dart. Amai Yuki's Flutter frontend on Provider-based state, including the custom camera module.
- Deployment: Vercel, Netlify, Render, Wasmer. Four platforms so far, each picked per project; this portfolio runs as a static Next.js build on Wasmer.

### FAQ

- Who is Sehaj Varma? An AI Automation Engineer and Backend Developer from India, open to remote work worldwide. He builds LLM agents, RAG pipelines, Python automation suites, and Flask backends — mostly for people tired of doing the same manual workflow for the hundredth time.
- What does he specialize in? Two overlapping things: workflow automation (Python scripts for scheduled jobs, file processing, API-to-API integration) and backend engineering (Flask REST APIs on clean SQLite schemas, validated and documented).
- What is Amai Yuki? His flagship project — a cross-platform real-time messaging app with direct and group chats, a custom in-app camera module, and Provider-based state architecture. Python/Flask backend with SQLite, Flutter/Dart frontend.
- What AI technologies does he work with? OpenAI and Gemini API integrations, prompt orchestration, RAG architecture, and conversational agents wired to external APIs so they answer from real data instead of guessing.
- What is his tech stack? AI, Backend, Automation, Frontend, Deployment — as listed in the Stack section above.
- Is he available for freelance work? Yes — AI automation, Python backends, API integration, freelance projects. Email mr.sehaj.official@gmail.com or reach him on GitHub.
